spec.context: Two versions of a public review workflow are compared as finite labelled transition systems. All states and action outcomes are declared below. Observations are the visible status only. There are no hidden steps, output events, clocks or external effects. Initial state is the first listed state of each version. Nondeterminism is an internal choice of a single successor, not two sequential moves.
